title: Add git commit identity guard
summary: Add a validation guard that scans current and upstream commit authors and committers for project-approved domains and bot identities, so autonomous workers catch identity drift before another push.
expectedFailureModes: A worker pushes a commit with a local or personal Git identity because validation only checks file content.
The guard rejects legitimate platform bot commits.
The guard scans all historical commits and blocks the repository on legacy identities instead of the active autonomous window.
The guard leaks private identity strings into repository docs or task records.
nextAction: Integrated locally; future hardening should add an optional pre-push hook installer around the same validator.
